data.short_description: Mystic Social Club is a new Caribbean-infused social club and restaurant planning to open in Dania Beach, FL. The indoor-outdoor venue will offer a menu drawing from multiple Caribbean islands, a full music program, and an attached rental lounge space. The project is currently in the permitting stage with an exact opening date to be announced.

Owner Marisa Flores said the interior is undergoing a major remodel and the location is targeting an opening in about one month.

Menu highlights include Italian hot dogs, Italian cheesesteaks, and specialty Italian pizza roll-style bread.

data.short_description: Tequila Real is a full-service Mexican restaurant and bar seating about 157 guests in a 3,100-square-foot space in Davenport, FL. The restaurant received a perfect 0-violation inspection score on June 2, 2026. Everything is made fresh daily and the menu includes 11 types of burritos and six to seven fajita choices.

Xurro, a churro-focused franchise with one other Florida location in Winter Haven, has started serving guests in Dundee, FL. The shop offers churros, churro milkshakes, and churro sundaes, and received a perfect inspection score on June 2, 2026.
Donde Wilking Restaurant passed its health inspection and is set to open on July 6th in Polk County, FL.

Taqueria El Viajero is replacing Brandon's Cafe at its Gainesville, GA location and is opening next week. The taqueria will serve tacos, burritos, burgers, and Mexican breakfast options seven days a week, and received a 100/A inspection report on June 15th.

Fun Spot America is permanently closing its Atlanta-area theme park on August 2nd after decades in Metro Atlanta. The closure comes three years after the park invested $13 million in its roller coaster Arie Force One, and amid financial difficulties including restructuring of a $25 million loan.

data.short_description: Award-winning food truck Double Dippin' is preparing its first brick-and-mortar restaurant in Holly Hill, FL, targeting a December opening. Owner Alyssa Allred has operated the food truck for four years and is building the restaurant around a birria-focused menu. The approximately 1,600-square-foot space will include an indoor dining area and a 700-square-foot lanai.

Two Jerks Tiki Bar & Grill is a planned waterfront tiki-style restaurant and grill for the longtime former DJ's Deck property in Port Orange, FL. The earliest current window is November or December 2026, with February or March also possible depending on project progress.

Heritage Supper Club, a concept from Bellevue Hospitality, is in the works at 63 Georgia Ave SE in Atlanta. Initially a pop-up, the brand has expanded its scope to cover cuisines across the African diaspora with a multi-course tasting menu.

Viva is a new taqueria from local operator Agustin Leon preparing to open at 39 Georgia Ave SE in Atlanta, in the space previously occupied by BOCA. The restaurant will offer a smaller, focused menu with counter service and a casual neighborhood atmosphere.

Library ATL is a new nightclub and lounge preparing to open in Norcross, GA, with a soft opening on June 30. The venue will feature a fusion of Nigerian, American, and Mediterranean dishes, Afrobeats and diverse music, and LGBTQ and Latino nights.

data.short_description: Tailored Smoke, a cigar lounge franchise based in Charlotte, NC, is preparing to open its first Atlanta-area location in Norcross, GA.

Poolie's BBQ & Grill plans a new restaurant, catering kitchen, and food truck hub in McDonough, GA, as the next stage after more than two and a half years operating a food trailer. The menu will center on Southern barbecue plates including pulled pork, brisket, smoked chicken wings, and sides, with dine-in and takeout options.

Keke's Breakfast Cafe is preparing to open in Hollywood, FL, targeting mid-July with a tentative date of July 16, and will seat close to 150 guests. Owner Ijmal Ali is also planning additional locations in Pembroke Pines, Tucker, and McDonough.
A second South Florida Keke's Breakfast Cafe location is planned for Pembroke Pines, FL, targeting an October opening with about 130 to 150 seats.

Library ATL is a new nightclub and lounge opening in Norcross, GA, with a soft opening on June 30 at 5 p.m. The venue will offer a fusion of Nigerian, American, and Mediterranean dishes plus classic club food, with lounge and nightclub hours from 5 p.m. to 2:30 a.m. six days a week.

Viva is a new taqueria from operator Agustin Leon opening in the former BOCA space in Atlanta's Summerhill neighborhood. The restaurant will offer counter service with a menu centered on tacos, burritos, tortas, quesadillas, and bowls, and will seat about 60 guests. Leon said the team is waiting on final approvals from the city with the exact date to be announced.

Poolie's BBQ & Grill is transitioning from a food trailer to a brick-and-mortar restaurant, catering kitchen, and food truck hub in McDonough, GA. The menu will focus on Southern barbecue including pulled pork, brisket, smoked chicken wings, and various sides, with dine-in and takeout options.

data.status: targeting a soft opening this week
data.short_description: 50'S Diner is a new 1950s-themed restaurant opening this week at International Drive in Orlando, FL, from owners Uriel Rivera and Felipe Osborn. The 1,400-square-foot space seats about 52 guests and offers quesadillas, burgers, pasta, pizza, fajitas, and milkshakes. A formal grand opening date is to be announced.

data.location: 118 South Pearl Street, Rocky Mount, NC 27804
data.short_description: Renaissance Rooftop is a new rooftop restaurant, bar, and event venue targeting a June opening in downtown Rocky Mount, NC. The venue will offer live music, networking events, wellness mornings, brunch, DJs, poetry, art, and private gatherings in an indoor-outdoor space seating 60–100 guests inside and 25–35 on the patio. The food and beverage program will include Eastern North Carolina-inspired dishes, handcrafted cocktails, and wellness beverages.

Ladder Company Cafe is preparing to open inside Lumberton's historic 1917 fire station, pending final health department approval. The cafe will offer about 35 seats with a casual dine-in menu focused on artisan sandwiches and lighter lunch options with no fried food. Owners Tommy and Gidget Vickers have spent two years restoring the building using historical documents to preserve its original character.

data.location: 139 SE Main St, Rocky Mount, NC (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Kabayan Bites has recently opened in Rocky Mount, NC, specializing in Filipino cuisine with dine-in and takeout service seven days a week from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. The menu includes dishes like Chicken Inasal, Tapsilog, Pansit Canton noodles, and a Kamayan feast served on banana leaves for groups of 6–8 or more.

data.location: 2116 New Bern Ave., Suite J, Raleigh, NC 27610
data.status: targeting an opening in the next two to four weeks
data.short_description: All Kinds is a new local craft shop with beer and wine targeting an opening in the next two to four weeks in Raleigh, NC. The shop will sell local crafts including pottery and artisan goods, with a beer and wine component, and may offer grab-and-go snacks. Owner Carl Vick is opening the business with his wife Allison next door to their existing Little Blue Bakehouse.

data.status: targeting an opening in the first week of November
data.short_description: La Victoria Raleigh is a full-service Mexican restaurant from Jalmex Hospitality targeting an opening in the first week of November in the former Mandolin space in Raleigh's Five Points area. The approximately 4,400-square-foot space will offer about 120 seats, a full bar, and a Tulum-inspired design using natural materials. The menu will feature elevated Mexican dishes and Tex-Mex offerings with higher-quality ingredients.

data.status: targeting a late August or early September opening
data.short_description: Burrito Shak is targeting a late August or early September opening at a new franchise location in Kannapolis, NC, in the new Kellswater Commons shopping center. Owners Mike and Christine Gracer will bring a beach-inspired, fast-casual concept with burritos, burrito bowls, tacos, and chips, seating about 40 guests inside with additional outdoor patio seating. Construction was anticipated to begin within about 30 days of receiving the keys on May 22, with a 90-day buildout.

Piedmont Delicatessen is preparing to open in downtown Gastonia, NC, combining a daytime deli, a hidden evening speakeasy, and a vintage baseball-inspired experience built around a preserved ghost mural of Piedmont cigarettes discovered during renovation. The opening menu will include four signature sandwiches and build-your-own options, with soups, salads, and smoothies planned as the business grows. Owners Jacinda and Derrick Jacobs and partners Preston and Somer Wilson are also considering a soft opening a few days before the June 22 grand opening.

data.status: a few weeks away from opening
data.short_description: Sammy's Boba and Coffee in Stockbridge, GA is a few weeks away from opening, with owner Sam Beng having invested his entire $250,000 stock portfolio into the build-out. The cafe will serve boba and coffee along with popcorn chicken, wings, Hong Kong-style bubble waffles, and Japanese taiyaki, requiring specialized equipment including a hood system and fryers. Beng completed pop-ups prior to investing to validate market demand.

Slava is a cafe-bakery being opened in downtown Asheville, NC by Ukrainian immigrant Svitlana Edie, offering dishes inspired by Ukrainian cuisine such as borscht and cabbage rolls. The concept is designed as a communal gathering space where people can share both everyday and meaningful moments over food.

data.short_description: Tiffin Box is a fast-casual Indian concept founded by Anesh Bodasing, with an existing location in Tallahassee and a new location opening soon in Gainesville, FL.

data.short_description: My Village Play Cafe is a new indoor play cafe concept in development in Cape Coral, FL, combining a cafe at the front with an indoor playground in the back across more than 3,400 square feet. The cafe will serve coffee, espresso drinks, teas, smoothies, panini, and children's food items, with parents able to supervise children from a bar counter facing the playground.

data.status: targeting an opening in two to three months
data.short_description: Double Take Market & Eatery is a specialty market and fast-casual eatery targeting an opening in two to three months in North Miami Beach, FL. The concept combines a Caribbean fusion restaurant with a grocery market featuring specialty dry goods, imported items, and fresh cuts of meat and seafood. The space is in the early stages of construction with plans for catering and meal prep services.

data.location: 723 SW Port St Lucie Blvd, Port St. Lucie, FL 34953
data.short_description: Dare Goes Da Pasta is a new fast-casual pasta and coffee concept planned for a 1,200-square-foot space in Port St. Lucie, FL, from owner Domenick Gonzalez. Guests will build pasta bowls Chipotle-style by choosing a pasta, sauce, and protein, with a sauce lineup including amatriciana, vodka, pesto, Alfredo, marinara, Bolognese, and a house Luciano-style sauce.

data.location: 9735 Old St Augustine Rd, Jacksonville, FL 32257
data.short_description: Fatboy Friedrice is preparing its first brick-and-mortar restaurant at 9735 Old St. Augustine Rd in Jacksonville, FL, with renovations about 90 percent complete. The fast-casual restaurant will seat 60–70 guests and serve as headquarters for the brand's food truck fleet, offering fried rice bowls, wings, fries, and planned additions of boba drinks and flavored lemonades.

Authentic Gyros & Grill is preparing to open a new fast-casual Mediterranean location in Tallahassee, FL, targeted within the next 30 days. The menu draws on owner Badr Kbiri Alaoui's recipes developed in Cyprus, with more than 20 wing flavors, seafood, and house-made cheese sauces, and plans to add breakfast service.

Authentic Gyros & Grill opened a new location in Fayetteville, GA, with its grand opening on June 9 after several soft-opening days with late-night hours. The Fayetteville location is also adding breakfast service.

data.location: Crestview, FL (address not specified — food truck)
data.short_description: Polynesian BBQ is a new food truck from Aleki and Lisa Siaki targeting an early July opening, serving Okaloosa County and surrounding areas from Crestview, FL. The menu will feature island-style barbecue including boneless chicken, ribs, turkey tail, hot dogs, and potato crab salad rooted in Aleki Siaki's Samoan background.

Mini & Me Play Cafe is a new family-centered cafe and play space planning to open in July in Pensacola, FL. The cafe will offer espresso drinks, croissants, bagels, fruit cups, and other snacks while children play in an attached playhouse with large windows and an open layout for parental supervision. Owner Valeria Barahona also plans art classes, book readings, and membership options for local families.
